name: Governed Model Context Externalization and Transport Security Hardening
objective: Harden the graduated GENERATE model-source-authoring boundary before any live model invocation by replacing whole RiverDevDevelopmentContext serialization with an explicit governed model-facing context projection that retains only source-authoring context required for the already-approved planning decision, excludes protected or excluded repository content from externalization, and requires TLS for remote credential-bearing model transport while preserving explicitly local loopback HTTP compatibility and all existing GENERATE-001 and GENERATE-002 governance, mutation, approval, and execution boundaries.
commitMessage: GENERATE-003: Harden model context externalization and transport security

generationContract.modelContextResponsibility: Construct an explicit model-facing projection from the authoritative GENERATE-001 provider input for the already-selected planning decision. Preserve sufficient governed repository source context for candidate source authoring without serializing the entire internal RiverDevDevelopmentContext.
generationContract.sourceContextBoundary: Model-facing context may include bounded source content only from context artifacts already admitted by authoritative context governance and relevant to the approved source-authoring request. Protected, excluded, secret-like, unrelated internal state, session state, and unnecessary repository metadata must not be externalized merely because they exist in RiverDevDevelopmentContext.
generationContract.governanceResponsibility: GENERATE-001 remains solely responsible for choosing approved decisions, enforcing allowed and excluded paths, duplicate rejection, overwrite semantics, deterministic intent assembly, and final RiverDevImplementationIntent validation.
generationContract.transportResponsibility: GENERATE-002 transport remains the only network boundary. Remote model endpoints carrying credentials must use HTTPS. Plain HTTP may be accepted only for explicit loopback-local endpoints used for local model transport.
generationContract.credentialBoundary: Credentials remain explicit caller-supplied inputs. GENERATE-003 must not discover environment credentials, dotenv files, repository secret files, or arbitrary credential stores.
generationContract.mutationBoundary: Provider and transport return in-memory candidate content only and perform no repository mutation.
generationContract.scopeBoundary: The model cannot select, add, replace, or broaden the target path. The exact target decision originates from authoritative GENERATE-001 governance.
generationContract.approvalBoundary: Model output creates no proposal approval, implementation approval, execution authorization, commit authorization, push authorization, or deployment authorization.
generationContract.liveInvocationBoundary: Live model invocation remains unauthorized by GENERATE-003 itself and requires a later explicit operator-controlled graduation boundary.

acceptanceCriteria: The model source-authoring provider no longer serializes the complete RiverDevDevelopmentContext into the model request.
The provider constructs a deterministic explicit model-facing context projection for the exact governance-selected planning decision.
The projection retains bounded governed source content sufficient for source authoring while omitting unnecessary internal development-context state.
Protected, excluded, and secret-like repository content is not externalized through the model-facing projection.
The provider cannot choose or broaden the target path and gains no repository, Git, shell, approval, execution, commit, push, or deployment authority.
The OpenAI-compatible transport rejects credential-bearing remote HTTP endpoints before network execution.
The transport accepts HTTPS remote endpoints.
The transport may accept plain HTTP only for explicit loopback-local endpoints such as localhost, 127.0.0.1, or IPv6 loopback.
Credentials remain explicit caller-supplied inputs and are not discovered from environment variables, dotenv files, repository files, or arbitrary secret stores.
Transport and provider errors do not intentionally include credential values.
Existing GENERATE-001 implementation-intent governance and downstream proposal lifecycle remain unchanged.
Fake-transport and fake-fetch tests prove context and transport hardening without live network access or credentials.
Historical manually authored implementation intents remain compatible.
No live model invocation is authorized by this phase.
approvalBoundaries: No protected, excluded, secret-like, or unnecessary internal development-context content may be externalized merely because it exists in RiverDevDevelopmentContext.
No repository mutation authority may originate from model output.
No execution authority may originate from model output.
No proposal approval may originate from model output.
No commit or push authority may originate from model output.
No ambient credential discovery is authorized.
No credential-bearing remote plaintext HTTP transport is authorized.
Live credential configuration and live model invocation remain a separate explicit operator-controlled boundary.
